name: SANOCEA Prospect Demo - Email Product Ingestion

nodes.name: Email Trigger (IMAP)
nodes.notes: Uses n8n's built-in generic IMAP trigger against Gmail (host imap.gmail.com, port 993, SSL) authenticated with a Gmail App Password - no Google Cloud Console OAuth app needed. Polls the inbox; a new message with a matching attachment fires this workflow.

nodes.name: POST /demo/email-ingest
nodes.notes: The ONLY place any authorization decision happens is inside SANOCEA itself. This node just delivers the raw payload with a service-role credential (packages/authn/deps.py::require_service) - the same role/mechanism already used for the background recovery worker.

nodes.name: Done (visible in Command Center)
nodes.notes: SANOCEA already recorded the full audit trail and, if routing/safety failed, refused the ingestion (fail closed) - this branch does nothing further by design. The Command Center's live-activity panel (apps/command_center/app.js) is what makes the result visible, not this workflow.

nodes.name: Stop And Error (routing/safety refused)
nodes.notes: PHASE C/N fail-closed behavior surfaced INTO n8n's own execution log too - an unrecognized routing address, untrusted sender, or unsafe attachment shows here as a real, loud workflow failure, never a silent drop.
